rows.headlineFinding: Six writes on a 110-field petition, and the ratio is the finding. An entire side belongs to the SBI, the AOC records officer, the court and the clerk; Side One additionally carries a CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE left blank in full on the contract's own ground that a certificate of mailing before mailing must stay blank, and a REQUEST BY JUDGE block. Paragraph 2's ten-year and twenty-year branches are classified as genuine participant elections rather than route selections, because the committed track registry records that the same-session question can move a petitioner between tiers or between ineligible and eligible.

rows.blocker: CC-6-12's paragraph 2 offers four branches under 'All charges against me in this matter (select one)': were dismissed; resulted in an acquittal; resulted in a conviction that was later pardoned; resulted in a conviction that was later set aside because I was a victim of sex trafficking. This family IS the pardoned branch, so the route determines that election and the packet must state it. The shared official-form finalizer refuses every non-text field by type guard ('non_text_field_type / type_guard'), so it cannot mark the box; the completeness contract names exactly this as a policy-shaped reason that yields ROUTE_OPTION_NOT_SELECTED, and a packet built for one statutory route may not hand the election back to the participant. Building the family without marking it would have shipped that defect.
rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A selection-mark path in this builder's core, of the kind scripts/build-census-v1-wv_conv_multiple_misdemeanors-set.mjs carries (kind 'selection_mark', drawn as path segments and proved from the artifact bytes). Porting it means extending the ink audit so a drawn mark is not counted as a glyph outside a measured write box, which has visual-gate consequences and belongs to a lane that owns that decision rather than to a family build.
rows.sourceBinding: BOTH BIND. official-form:CC-6-12 and official-form:CC-6-12a are pinned to d_source_packs paths this container does not mount, and both digests are matched byte-exact in the mounted Master Library.
rows.alsoObserved: On CC-6-12 the page-2 contact block's caption capture is one blank out of step — 'citystatezip' is captured as 'Street Address/P.O. B' and 'telephone number' as 'City/State/ZIP Code'. The phone write lands correctly because the binding follows the field name, but the captions are not trustworthy on that block and a builder should not rely on them.
